featured_reviews.name: Rayan Serrao
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am not satisfied with the service. In fact the quality of service in Mumbai Cycles compared to Bharat cycles has gone down. Mumbai cycles only focuses on selling cycles, but fail to deliver parts when required.

I was facing issues with my road bike, and they recommended me to change the chain. It’s been more than 9 months (23/01/2025 - 17/10/2025) and multiple fake promises but they failed to deliver.

Finally after giving up on Mumbai Cycles, i called two local shops and at both places chain was available.

I wonder if a normal person can easily arrange spare parts, then why does it take 9+ months to a co called Branded cycle dealer to arrange parts!!!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hello Rayan,

We appreciate that you shared your honest thoughts, and we would also like to clarify a few things to maintain complete transparency.

We have been servicing your bikes for a long time, and the issue you mentioned was specifically about the chain for your road bike. The original chain for your model was not in stock, and we have consistently updated you about this — all of which is documented.

Pawan had also informed you about an alternative compatible chain from another brand. You chose not to go ahead with it due to its cost, which we fully respected. Later, we informed you that we would not be able to arrange the original chain and suggested that if you managed to source it from a third-party supplier, we would be happy to install it for you. You agreed, we completed the service accordingly, and you left satisfied.

Regarding your point that the chain was easily available with another shop — that may be true. Sometimes certain shops happen to have stock even when the authorized dealer does not. However, we cannot simply procure inventory from competing stores. Their availability was a matter of timing and luck.

We genuinely try our best, but yes, it’s not always possible to keep everyone happy. If this situation caused you disappointment, that is your choice and we respect it — but it’s also important for us to clarify the full picture.

Since you shared the negative experience, we feel it’s fair to also highlight the many times you’ve visited us for regular services for both your road bike and your MTB, and how happily you’ve enjoyed your rides afterwards. If our service was truly unsatisfactory, you wouldn’t have continued trusting us over multiple visits.

Thank you, Rayan, for your review.
We appreciate your feedback and hope this helps clear things up.
